title: When the Portrait Turns
author: Emrys Sterling
blurb: Isandro Underhill, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
